search_text: published ZDI-21-192 ZDI-CAN-11903 SolarWinds Orion Platform NCM SCM IPAM SaveUserSetting Improper Access Control Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2021-12-08 CVE-2021-27258 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-27258 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['SolarWinds'] ['Orion Platform'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute escalate privileges on affected installations of SolarWinds Orion Platform. title: SolarWinds Orion Platform NCM SCM IPAM SaveUserSetting Improper Access Control Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute escalate privileges on affected installations of SolarWinds Orion Platform. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SaveUserSetting endpoint. The issue results from improper restriction of this endpoint to unprivileged users. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges their privileges from Guest to Administrator.
